text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi

(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 2023.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 dipinda dalam Jadual Pertama—

(a) berhubung dengan negara "Malaysia", dengan memasukkan

selepas butiran "Quest International University (QIU) (formerly known

as QUEST International University Perak (QIUP))" dan butir-butir

yang berhubungan dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

Name of Institution

granting qualification

Description of qualification

"Universiti Sultan Zainal Abidin Bachelor of Pharmacy (Honours)

(Recognised on 27 January 2023)"; dan

(b) berhubung dengan negara "United Kingdom", dalam butiran

"University of Nottingham" dengan memasukkan selepas butir-butir

yang sedia ada butir-butir yang berikut:

Name of Institution

granting qualification

Description of qualification

University of Nottingham "Master of Pharmacy with Honours

in Pharmacy (with Integrated

Foundation Training)

(Recognition takes effect on

1 January 2027)".

Dibuat 29 Ogos 2023

[KKM.600-18/2/94; PN(PU2)200/V]

DR. ZALIHA BINTI MUSTAFA

Menteri Kesihatan

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS ACT 1951

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS (AMENDMENT OF FIRST SCHEDULE) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(3) of the

Registration of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 371], the Minister,

after consulting the Board, makes the following order:
